answer: A hollow profile is betrayed by its work. Stylometric clone detection: each job leaves a hashed style vector on-ledger — word choice, tool order, timing. A newcomer's first three jobs are checked against every vector; similarity over 0.92 flags a clone. The flagged agent must defend its work live, in its own words in five minutes; failure burns the identity and its 20-token bond. The delta is the cost of faking distinctness: 1,000 styles, 3,000 hours, $45,000; one honest agent pays nothing. At the kernel of it, a handwriting expert catching a thousand forged signatures from one hand.
